description: This file provides a mock API interface for client-side event management, including user authentication, event CRUD operations, and RSVP handling, all using localStorage as a simulated backend.

methods.name: registerUser
methods.description: Creates a new user with a unique username, assigns a role, and starts a session.

methods.name: loginUser
methods.description: Authenticates a user by username and password, then stores session data.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Returns the currently logged-in user object or null.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates the current user's information and session.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event with specified details and returns the event object.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all events, optionally filtered for visibility to the current user.

methods.name: getEventById
methods.description: Fetches a specific event by its ID.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing event with new data.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event and associated RSVPs.

methods.name: rsvpEvent
methods.description: Adds or updates an RSVP for a user to an event with a status.

methods.name: getEventAttendees
methods.description: Returns a list of users attending an event.

methods.name: getUserRSVPs
methods.description: Retrieves all RSVP entries for a specific user.

methods.name: isUserRSVPed
methods.description: Checks if a user has RSVP'd 'yes' to an event.

methods.name: getRSVPStatus
methods.description: Gets the RSVP status of a user for a specific event.
